title: Standard K-injective resolutions for strict abelian-group towers
statement: For each universe $u$, let $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathbf{Ab}_u)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},\mathbf{Ab}_u)$ be the category of strict towers of abelian groups [def-weil-inverse-system]. Use its existing simultaneous K-injective resolution instance: every unbounded cochain complex $K$ of such towers admits a quasi-isomorphism $K\to I$ with $I$ K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. The instance is the standard Grothendieck construction [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]: the separating family is obtained by applying the finite-prefix left adjoints of evaluation to a separator of abelian groups; coproduct of that family gives a separator, and exact filtered colimits are pointwise. Apply the existing Grothendieck K-injective resolution construction. This defines the chosen existing instance, without adding a hypothesis of boundedness or exactness of inverse limit.
